title: Water in the morning
body: Water early so foliage dries before night, reducing fungal disease.

title: Mulch conserves water
body: A 5cm layer of organic mulch can cut watering needs dramatically.

title: Deadhead for more blooms
body: Removing spent flowers redirects energy into new blooms.

title: Rotate your crops
body: Avoid planting the same family in one spot two years running to reduce pests and disease.

title: Feed the soil
body: Healthy soil grows healthy plants. Add compost each season.

title: Walk the garden daily
body: A short daily walk catches pests and problems before they spread.
